source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Check the status of the inspection record to see if it has been closed or failed.
3. If it succeeds, proceed to the next step.
4. Invalidate all inspections from the previous step, and all of the following steps will be carried out in tandem.
5. Upload an image/video showing the reason the inspection failed.
6. Create a new building with the same details as the current inspection record but different latitude and longitude (with the changed latitude and longitude within a minimum distance of 10km)
7. Assign the new building to a user for inspection purposes.
8. After receiving inspection results indicating failure (i.e the building is inaccessible or does not exist), the record will be stored.
9. Create a new inspection record for the previous building, but this time provide accessible latitude/longitude coordinates for the building.
10. Complete the current inspection by submitting the result.
